dataset.description: Which dataset to diff. 'ship-components' covers ship weapons, shields, coolers, power plants, quantum drives and radars; 'strings' is the localisation table, useful for spotting renamed or newly added content.

from_version.description: Older version, e.g. '4.9' or a full build string like '4.9.0-LIVE.12344265'.

collection.description: Optional: which collection inside the dataset to diff. Defaults to the main one (e.g. 'weapons' for ship-components); pass 'shields', 'quantumDrives', 'radars' or 'missiles' to diff those instead.

item_name.description: Optional: restrict to entries matching this name or class name (e.g. 'AD5B', 'Mantis', 'Talon'). Returns field-level changes.

limit.description: Max entries listed per category in summary mode (default 50).

enrich.description: Add public stats to each ship (default true). false lists the file as is, with no network.

name.description: Name exactly as listed in the fleet (case does not matter).

origin.description: Needed only when the name exists under both origins.

name.description: Ship name, e.g. 'Drake Vulture' or 'C2 Hercules Starlifter'.

origin.description: 'pledge' for a ship bought with real money, 'in_game' for one bought with aUEC.

notes.description: Optional note, up to 500 characters (loadout idea, role, location).

include_commodities.description: Include tradeable commodity names from UEX Corp (default true).

include_manufacturers.description: Include ship/vehicle manufacturer names from the Star Citizen Wiki (default true).

include_weapons.description: Include FPS and ship weapon names, ~580 terms (default true).

include_attachments.description: Include weapon attachment names (scopes, magazines, ...), ~106 terms (default true).

include_armor.description: Include armor piece names, ~2400 terms including colour variants (default false).

include_clothes.description: Include clothing item names, ~1900 terms including colour variants (default false).

include_components.description: Include ship component names (shields, coolers, quantum drives, ...), ~3300 terms (default false).

limit.description: Cap on locally extracted labels merged in (default 1000).
How many builds to return (default 40, max 100).

plan.description: Optional route plan to show next to the measured balance change. Cargo is not measured by the game: the balance change is the only measure.

expected_profit_auec.description: Planned PROFIT in aUEC (sales minus purchases at the planned prices, before any fee). Not a turnover.

buy_unit_price.description: Planned buying price, aUEC per SCU.

sell_unit_price.description: Planned selling price, aUEC per SCU.

est_trip_minutes.description: Estimated trip time of the route, in minutes.

price_points.description: Recent prices per SCU, oldest first (at most 30), taken from the UEX price tools, for the price curve. The price curve never comes from a dashboard call to UEX.

price_points_for.description: Which price the points are (sell when absent).

price_points_label.description: The period of the points in words, for example '7 derniers jours'.

after_seq.description: Only events with a higher seq (default 0).

limit.description: At most this many, the newest (default 30, max 100).

include_balance.description: Include balance-change events (default true; false hides them).

action.description: start or end a session, or restart the balance change from now.

include_balance.description: Include the aUEC balance and its change. Default true; false hides it. Ignored (hidden) while the player's choice is hidden.

balance_choice.description: Only after a CLICK of the player on the balance toggle: the server remembers it (memory only).

balance_token.description: The token the page carries: required for balance_choice shown and for balance_once. Without it they are refused.

balance_once.description: With include_balance true: the balance for this answer only, for the route button the player pressed. Changes no choice.

include_static.description: Include the list of what the stream never contains. The View asks once.

since_seq.description: The newest event number the View holds: only newer events come back.

have.description: Hashes (the `hash` of a previous answer) of the sections the View holds; a section with the same hash is left out and listed in `unchanged`.

sections.description: Only these parts (default all). Smaller answers cost less.

include_balance.description: Include the aUEC balance and its change since the reader started. Default true; false hides it (the player's choice).

limit.description: Events to return, the most recent ones (default 30, max 100).

since_minutes.description: Only events from the last N minutes (by the log's own clock, UTC).

version.description: Update to read, e.g. '4.10.2' or '4.10' (newest 4.10.x). Default: the newest listed.

section.description: Part of a section heading to read in full (e.g. 'Ships', 'Hauling', 'Bug fixes').

search.description: A word or phrase to find in the notes; returns the passages and their headings.

dataset.description: Dataset name, e.g. 'game-mining' or 'game-blueprints'. See sc_local_datasets.

query.description: Case-insensitive term to match against keys, names and record contents.

collection.description: Optional: restrict to one collection within the dataset.

include_balance.description: Include aUEC figures (balances, results, turnover, rate per hour). Default true; false hides them (the player's choice).

format.description: Default markdown. csv is the trips only.

include_balance.description: Include aUEC figures (results, margins, fees, rate). Default true; false hides them (the player's choice).

include_start_balance.description: With include_balance only: also the balance at the start and at the last sighting. Default false. The player must ask for it.

csv_delimiter.description: CSV separator: "," (default) or ";" (Excel in French opens it in columns; decimal comma).

last.description: The newest N sessions that hold something (1 to 10). Default 1. Not with id.

include_balance.description: Include aUEC figures (results, margins, fees, rate). Default true; false hides them (the player's choice).

include_start_balance.description: With include_balance only: also the balance at the start and at the last sighting. Default false. The player must ask for it.

csv_delimiter.description: CSV separator: "," (default) or ";" (Excel in French opens it in columns; decimal comma).

include_balance.description: Include aUEC figures (balances, results, turnover, rate per hour). Default true; false hides them (the player's choice).

last.description: Only the newest N sessions (1 to 200). Default: all.

include_balance.description: Include aUEC figures (balances, results, turnover, rate per hour). Default true; false hides them (the player's choice).

sessions.description: How many of the newest log files to scan (default 2, max 10). Files with no trade are left out.

max_transactions.description: Most recent transactions listed per session (default 40, max 120; at most 120 in all). Totals and runs always cover the whole session.

resolve_names.description: Look commodity names up in the wiki's public commodity list (default true). The list is the same for everyone: nothing from the log is sent. False keeps it fully local.

include_balance.description: Include the aUEC amounts (line totals, unit prices, cost, revenue, gross margin, spending). Default true; false hides them (the player's choice).

action.description: search for routes, apply an option of a previous answer as the plan, check that the plan in force still holds (preflight, no other argument), or list the hold sizes known for the player (holds, no other argument).

armistice_only.description: Only stops UEX flags as armistice zones (search).

min_reports.description: Require at least this many player reports at every end (search).

budget_private.description: The budget comes from the player's balance: no cost in the answer (search).

origin.description: Where to start: a terminal, planet or system name (search).

use_ship.description: Use the flown ship's quantum speed and hold (search). Default true.

next_run.description: The id of the completed run this suggestion is for: computed once per run (search).

id.description: The random id of an option, to apply as the plan (apply).

with_balance.description: The balance is shown: a plan built from it may reach the saved session (apply).

to.description: Show the update that ends at a build whose name contains this text (e.g. '4.10.2'). Default: the newest.

channel.description: Game channel: 'live' (default) or 'ptu' (test build, may be absent). The build used is in provenance.

mode.description: templates (default): datamined contract families. offers: price the offers given in `offers` (used by default when `offers` is present).

ship_name.description: Ship (e.g. 'Cutlass Black'): hold and container sizes from UEX, quantum speed from the wiki. Use sc_fleet_get for the player's ships.

cargo_scu.description: Hold size in SCU (wins over the ship's), e.g. when only part of it is free.

max_container_size.description: Largest container size in SCU the ship takes (wins over UEX's list).

quantum_speed_ms.description: offers: quantum speed in m/s when there is no ship_name.

stop_minutes.description: offers: assumed minutes per stop, fractions allowed (default 8, an unmeasured assumption).

rank.description: templates: the player's Hauling rank (Trainee, Rookie, Junior, Member, Experienced, Senior or Master): contracts outside it are left out. Omit to keep all.

system.description: templates: keep contracts that run in this system ('Stanton', 'Pyro', 'Nyx').

include_illegal.description: templates: also show illegal contracts (default false).

include_unfit.description: templates: also show contracts whose containers are too big for the ship, flagged (default false).

sort.description: templates: reward_per_scu (default; by the low end of the range) or reward. With a ship, fit comes first (containers, then trips).

offers.description: offers: 1 to 10 offers as seen in the mobiGlas (2 or more to compare and bundle).

title.description: Optional title, for your own reference.

max_container_size.description: Optional: the largest container size in SCU the offer uses.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the product name, type or manufacturer. Case, accents and punctuation do not matter; with no exact match, close spellings are tried.

type.description: Product type or gear class, e.g. 'weapons', 'armour', 'shield', 'mininglaser'.

uses_resource.description: Only blueprints whose recipe uses this resource or item (e.g. 'Titanium').

include_sources.description: Also list the missions that can reward each blueprint (default true; false is faster on the first call).

channel.description: Game channel: 'live' (default) or 'ptu' (test build, may be absent). The build used is in provenance.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the ore, laser or module name (e.g. 'quantainium', 'helix'). Case, accents and punctuation do not matter; with no exact match, close spellings are tried.

channel.description: Game channel: 'live' (default) or 'ptu' (test build, may be absent). The build used is in provenance.

query.description: Words that must all appear in title, contractor, type, place or blueprint reward (e.g. 'wikelo', 'bounty pyro'). Case, accents and punctuation do not matter; with no exact match, close spellings are tried.

mission_type.description: Part of the mission type (e.g. 'Hauling', 'Bounty Hunter', 'Salvage', 'Delivery').

location.description: Place, planet, moon or star system the mission uses (e.g. 'Pyro', 'Hurston').

illegal.description: true for illegal missions only, false to exclude them.

reward_blueprint.description: Part of the name of a blueprint the mission can reward.

channel.description: Game channel: 'live' (default) or 'ptu' (test build, may be absent). The build used is in provenance.

name.description: The name of the item (e.g., 'FS-9 LMG', 'Lynx Helmet').

ship_names.description: List of ship names to compare (e.g., ['Ursa Medivac', 'Cutlass Red']).

category.description: Which catalog to browse. 'vehicle-items' = ship components (shields, coolers, quantum drives), 'vehicle-weapons' = ship weapons, 'weapons' = FPS weapons. Defaults to 'items' (everything).

type.description: Optional: Item type (e.g., 'Shield', 'Cooler', 'Quantum Drive', 'Power Plant', 'Weapon Gun', 'Missile').

is_spaceship.description: Optional: true for spaceships only, false for ground vehicles only.

to_label.description: Label of the newer snapshot. Omit to compare against current live data.

label.description: Optional: Label for this snapshot (defaults to the game_version reported by the API).

type.description: Optional (items only): Restrict snapshot to one item type (e.g., 'Shields', 'WeaponPersonal').

category.description: UEX item category of the first item (and of the second unless category_b).

category_b.description: Optional: category of the second item.

size_a.description: Optional: size of the first item.

size_b.description: Optional: size of the second item.

side.description: buy = where the player can BUY it (cheapest first), sell = where the player can SELL it (best price first), both = two lists (default).

limit.description: Rows per list (default 15, max 50). The total count is always given.

include_older_versions.description: Also return rows from an older game version than LIVE (default false: they are left out and counted).

item_name.description: Words of the item name (e.g. 'Burst', 'FR-66', 'P4-AR'). A close spelling is tried when nothing matches exactly.

category.description: UEX item category or section (e.g. 'Quantum Drives', 'Guns', 'Foods'). At most three categories are opened. An unknown or too wide name returns the list of categories in `categories`.

star_system_name.description: Optional: only terminals in this system (exact, e.g. 'Stanton').

limit.description: Items to price when several match (default 3, max 4).

locations.description: Rows per side, buy and sell, per item (default 8, max 15). The answer is cut, and says so, if it would be too large.

with_attributes.description: Add the item's stats from UEX (one more request per item). Default false.

only_warnings.description: Only rows that carry a critical or warning level (default false: all rows).

max_age_days.description: A row older than this is flagged stale (default 7). Rows are never hidden for age.

item_name.description: Item name or part of it (e.g. 'MG Scrip', 'Wikelo'). Must be unique or exact; several matches are listed.

id_item.description: UEX item id, when known (wins over item_name).

operation.description: Optional: one side only. 'sell' = players offering the item (what you pay), 'buy' = players wanting it (what you are paid).

include_history.description: Add a summary of recent adverts (price changes of the last 30 days). Heavy: UEX sends up to 1000 rows and the summary then covers only the newest ones, which it says. Default false.

check_price.description: Optional: a price per unit to place against the recent average (needs operation).

limit.description: Without an item: how many of the most traded items (default 15, max 50).

terminal_name.description: Terminal name or nickname (e.g. 'CBD Lorville' or 'TDD Area 18').

ore.description: Ore to refine (e.g. 'Laranite', 'Gold', 'Quantainium'; '(Raw)' or '(Ore)' is optional). Omit to rank all ores.

star_system_name.description: Optional: only refineries in this star system (exact name, e.g. 'Stanton', 'Pyro', 'Nyx').

limit.description: Rows to return (default 10, max 30): refineries, or ores without `ore`.

include_methods.description: With `ore`: add the refining methods with UEX's 1 to 3 ratings for yield, cost and speed (default true). The ratings are not numbers of aUEC or minutes.

vehicle_name.description: The name of the ship (e.g., 'Ursa Medivac', 'Carrack').

include_rentals.description: Include rental locations as well as purchase locations (default true).

terminal_id.description: The UEX terminal ID (e.g., 473 for Ruin Station Buy and Fly).

terminal_name.description: Optional: Terminal name to search for (e.g., 'Ruin Station', 'Checkmate').

inventory_type.description: Type of inventory to retrieve (ships, weapons, armor, components, or all).

commodity_name.description: Commodity to haul (e.g. 'Laranite'). Exact name first, then a unique partial match.

origin_terminal_name.description: Terminal to buy at (e.g. 'Admin - ARC-L1' or 'ARC-L1').

origin_planet_name.description: Planet whose terminals to buy at (e.g. 'ArcCorp').

cargo_capacity.description: Cargo capacity in SCU (e.g. 696). Wins over ship_name when both are given.

ship_name.description: A ship to haul with (e.g. 'C2 Hercules Starlifter'): its cargo capacity in SCU is used. Matched by words; several ships that fit are listed instead of guessed.

limit.description: Routes to return, best profit first (default 10, max 50).

min_reports.description: Drop routes that have fewer than this many player reports at the origin OR at the destination (default 0: keep UEX estimates, but rank them after reported routes). 1 = only routes both ends of which a player has reported.

objective.description: profit_per_hour (default), profit (per run), speed (shortest run), safety (fewest risk factors of the heuristic).

ship_name.description: Ship to haul with (e.g. 'Caterpillar'): cargo from UEX, quantum speed from the wiki sheet.

cargo_scu.description: Hold size in SCU (wins over the ship's).

quantum_speed_ms.description: Quantum speed in m/s when there is no ship (e.g. 238314300 for a Cutlass Black).

armistice_only.description: Only stops that UEX flags as armistice zones (unknown counts as no).

max_legs.description: 1 = one-way routes only (needs an origin); 2 (default) = also round trips and two-leg chains.

max_age_days.description: Leave out prices older than this (default 7).

include_stale.description: Keep old prices, flagged stale (default false).

min_reports.description: Drop options with fewer player reports than this at an end (default 0).

stop_minutes.description: Assumed minutes per stop (landing, terminal, takeoff). Default 8.

query.description: Text to match against listing title/description (case-insensitive).

id_item.description: Optional: filter by UEX item id. Combine with operation to unlock the 1,000-row cap.

username.description: Optional: filter by advertiser in-game name.
